title: Storage object URLs without any signing parameters
summary: The same synthetic storage object URL shapes as the signed positives, with the signing query parameters absent: a plain object link for each of the three providers.
rationale: The near-neighbor of the signed positives: same host and path, no signature. The providers document the capability as carried by the signing parameters; a URL without them carries none, whether or not the object happens to be publicly readable (not claimed here). Prevents a rule keyed on the storage host or object path from flagging the address.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. Each provider documents access as granted by signing parameters appended to the resource URI (AWS SigV4 query parameters, X-Goog-Signature, SAS sig); a URL with none of them contains no such value. This asserts nothing about whether the object is public.

sources.supports: A shared access signature is a token that is appended to the URI for an Azure Storage resource.
Signed URL query parameters X-Goog-Signature and related.
Authentication information carried in X-Amz-* query parameters.
